Key negotiation levers I think we can use (for Aditya / Legal):
- Additional Insured scope: propose limiting to liability arising out of Redwood’s delivery of services under the Order Form (vs. all operations).
- Endorsement form: prefer to offer a tailored endorsement (or CG 20 37 where available) rather than blanket CG 20 10. CG 20 37 is narrower in practice.
- Primary/non-contributory: consider accepting for contract-specific liability only; avoid blanket acceptance across policies.
- Waiver of subrogation: conditional — subject to carrier approval (common ask).
- Retroactive date: we cannot commit to backdating beyond policy inception; ask procurement whether they require a specific date tied to legacy claims.

What I need from you both:
- Aditya: proposed endorsement language (1–2 sentences) we can send to the broker; confirm whether the limits as requested are acceptable or whether countersuggestion needed.
- Lauren: if procurement pushes on COI timing, can Sales Ops run signature hold if endorsement pending? Need to know if we can delay execution by 48–72 hours.

I’ve flagged the items with our broker (Jules Martin) and he’s standing by to produce a COI and endorsement once we give direction.

Thanks — Diego

Amelia — thanks for the clear summary and the sample COI. Apologies for the delay here; had to confirm a couple of carrier constraints. Below is what Redwood can commit to for the Order Form tied to Quantify AI. If any point is a hard requirement on your side, let us know and I’ll escalate.

1) Limits: We can meet the following limits for this engagement: CGL $2M/$4M, Professional Liability (E&O) $3M. Cyber/Privacy coverage is with a carrier that provides $3M standard — we can consider an exception for $5M if Quantify can accept excess placement with our broker; please advise if $5M is absolute.

2) Additional Insured / Endorsement: Redwood can provide Additional Insured status to "Quantify AI, Inc. and its subsidiaries" but only as to liability arising out of Redwood's services performed under the Order Form (i.e., operations-based limitation). We will provide either a CG 20 37 endorsement or a Redwood-tailored endorsement with materially similar scope. We cannot agree to a blanket additional insured grant covering all operations.

3) Primary / Non-Contributory: We will accept primary/non-contributory treatment limited to claims related to Redwood’s obligations under the Order Form and only to the extent permitted by the underlying policy language. Carrier approval required.

4) Waiver of Subrogation: We can waive subrogation in favor of Quantify, subject to insurer consent. If your broker requires mandatory waiver language, please have them coordinate directly with our broker (Jules Martin) — I’ve CC’d him so we can move quickly.

5) Retroactive Date: We cannot backdate coverage beyond the policy inception date. If Quantify needs a specific retroactive date tied to prior acts coverage, tell us the exact date and we will check with the carrier but cannot promise retroactive backdating on short notice.

6) COI & Endorsement ETA: Once the parties agree to the endorsement form above, our broker can issue a COI and the endorsement within 7 business days from countersignature. If Quantify needs the COI before execution, we can provide a pre-execution COI and mark signature status, but final endorsement issuance will be post-signature.

Proposed compromise language for the MSA endorsement clause (you can paste this into the Order Form):
"To the extent permitted by the insurer, Redwood Inference will add Quantify AI, Inc. and its subsidiaries as Additional Insureds for liability arising out of Redwood’s performance under this Order Form. Such Additional Insured status shall be limited to liability for which Redwood would otherwise be liable and shall be subject to the terms and conditions of Redwood’s insurance policies; acceptance of primary, non-contributory treatment and waiver of subrogation is subject to carrier approval."

If that looks acceptable, Diego — can you tell Jules to produce the draft endorsement and COI and send to Amelia’s procurement email. Amelia — CC’d is our broker (Jules Martin) to speed the handoff. I’ll make myself available to address any lined-in legal points.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Associate General Counsel | Redwood Inference
